Projects

HealthGPT

A small GPT built from scratch. Type a disease name and it returns common first-line care tips. It has a 4-layer transformer, a custom BPE tokenizer and a train/validation split. Educational only, not medical advice.

PythonPyTorchTransformersColab
Download .ipynb

Well Digital Twin

An interactive dashboard that simulates an oil well using cyclic steam stimulation and a sucker rod pump. It runs on synthetic data and follows the inject, soak and produce phases on a timeline you can scrub.

HTMLCSSJavaScriptSimulation
Full page

Cabinet: Medicine Tracker

Keeps track of the medicines at home. It shows what has expired, what expires soon and what is still fine, and it helps you dispose of old medicines safely.

HTMLCSSJavaScriptHealth

Verifier OS

Explainable AI for Diabetic Retinopathy

An informational website on screening for diabetic retinopathy in rural India, focused on explainable AI that shows what the model sees, not just what it says.

2-Relay Smart Socket

An IoT switch built on an ESP8266 NodeMCU. It controls 2 relays from the Blynk app and from physical switches, still works with no WiFi, and remembers relay states after a power cut.
